lines.t: I am The Lord’s!
And I will no more give myself to diverse lusts,
to the cares and deceits of my flesh and this world...
I AM THE LORD’S!
My heart, it is The Lord’s;
My mind, it is The Lord’s;
My will, it is The Lord’s;
My flesh, it is The Lord’s;
the whole of my body,
even all I am, I give to The Lord...
I am The Lord’s!
Yea, I pour out my life before The Lord,
even as He poured out His;
let me receive it!
In the name of My Love,
I call out in YahuShua’s name,
I ask to receive it!...
YahuShua, My Life and My Righteousness,
I want Your life!... My Lord and my God, I am yours!
Do with me as You please,
according to the good pleasure of Your will.
I give myself away.
Amen.
